summary: Verified vacancy loading end-to-end on the public preview URL (https://hr-palette-refresh.preview.emergentagent.com). Backend GET /api/vacancies returns 200 with items (20 per page, total ~525) and GET /api/vacancies/{id} returns 200 for a fresh id. Frontend /vacancies renders 20 vacancy cards + 9 new-update cards; homepage / renders same 20 vacancy cards; clicking data-testid='vacancy-0' navigates to /vacancies/{id} and the detail page with data-testid='vacancy-detail-page' renders including the WhatsApp Summary card. All three filter dropdowns work (category=admit_card -> 16 cards, state=haryana -> 5 cards, qualification=10th kept 20). Page is NOT blank. Only console noise is the expected webpushr 'Error 4' and the 401 on /api/auth/me while anonymous, both explicitly whitelisted in the request.
verified_flows: /vacancies page: 20 vacancy-{n} cards + 9 new-update-{n} cards; body length ~5245 (not blank)
Click vacancy-0 -> navigates to /vacancies/{id}, data-testid='vacancy-detail-page' present, WhatsApp summary card present
Filters: vacancies-qualification-filter, vacancies-category-filter, vacancies-state-filter all present and re-filter list without blanking page (category admit_card=16, state haryana=5)
console_notes: PAGEERROR 'Unexpected token E, "Error 4: S"...' from webpushr and 401 on /api/auth/me are the only errors — both are the expected/ignored noise called out in the review request. No React render errors, no CORS errors, no failed vacancy API calls.
critical_code_review_comments: User's report 'vacancy load nahi ho rahi' could not be reproduced on the current preview URL — likely a stale browser cache / old preview domain on user's side. Consider adding a Cache-Control: no-store header on the /vacancies HTML shell (or bumping the SW/build hash) so returning users pick up new bundles automatically.

The webpushr 'Error 4: Site key invalid' throws an uncaught runtime error every page load; while harmless to rendering, it pollutes error monitoring. Wrap the webpushr init in a try/catch or fix the site key placeholder.
test_credentials: Not required — public pages tested anonymously.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vacancy loading works fully on https://hr-palette-refresh.preview.emergentagent.com. Vacancy ids are ephemeral (live scrape) so always fetch a fresh id from /api/vacancies before hitting /api/vacancies/{id}. If user still reports 'not loading' it is almost certainly client-side cache/old domain, not a code bug.
rca_of_the_issue: Not a code bug. Backend returns 200 with items; frontend renders 20 vacancy cards + 9 new-update cards on both / and /vacancies; detail page and filters all work. User-side likely cached old bundle or is on an older preview host. Recommend cache-bust / hard reload.
